changelog:
Initial release of work-productivity-skillscan-security-workflow-helper.

- Provides practical help for SkillScan-style workflows on Clawhub, targeting bug fixes, setup hardening, reliability, and adjacent skill creation.
- Implements a six-step workflow: clarifies user needs, offers reusable plans or artifacts, minimizes manual coordination, and validates outputs.
- Delivers tailored outputs, reusable checklists, and validation notes to ensure actionable, user-friendly results.
- Designed with strong demand validation (11 online signals, 4 source families; demand score 100/100).
- Triggered by keywords and phrases related to productivity, security, bug-fixing, and workflow automation.
